density.flip_rate_max_pool.spec: MAE-vs-RMSE winner flip rate at the largest pool size swept

density.flip_rate_min_pool.spec: MAE-vs-RMSE winner flip rate at the smallest pool size (n_models=2)

density.flip_rate_monotonic_increasing.spec: whether the raw flip-rate curve rises STRICTLY with pool size over the swept range (n_models=2..9, every step a real increase, not just non-decreasing) -- if true, the curve itself does not visibly plateau within this range. Section 9 does not read an identification verdict off this curve: it says the M4 crowding arm 'is not a reliable identification signal on its own: on a 61-row panel the independence null is too unstable to read'. This producer computes NO independence null for this curve at all, and none is available elsewhere: the arena.m4_flip_null_* keys are a different measurement on a different panel (a mean-loss-vs-Borda flip rate over the 61 M4 SUBMISSIONS x 4 metrics, pools up to 60), not a null for this MAE-vs-RMSE curve over ~1500 M4-Monthly SERIES x 9 models

density.n_series.spec: number of M4-Monthly series sampled for the leaderboard-density curve
